evals.prompt: Create a simple Python script that demonstrates the auto-type functionality and save it as test_script.py, then use the python-auto-type skill to automatically input this code
evals.expected_output: A test Python script should be created and the auto-type skill should simulate typing it with realistic delays and error corrections

evals.prompt: Use the python-auto-type skill to input a Python script that contains Markdown code blocks (with ```python markers) to verify that the skill properly filters out the markdown markers
evals.expected_output: The auto-type skill should skip the ```python and ``` markers and only type the actual Python code

evals.prompt: Test the python-auto-type skill with custom parameters: use a faster delay (0.02s), lower error rate (0.02), and shorter thinking time (0.3-0.8s) for a quick typing demonstration
evals.expected_output: The skill should use the custom parameters for faster, more accurate typing simulation
